method.candidate: Strict original complete checkpoint; CPU float32, eager attention,2threads; one8-picture center window from first32 sampled pictures; original preprocessing; no padding/guessed clocks
method.baseline: Existing two production synthesis adapters; commercial policy/full profile, MPS float32,2CPUthreads; mean of available finite raw probabilities. Individual failed statuses remain failures; all-inapplicable remains unassessed. Candidate CPU versus baseline MPS latency is not a like-hardware speed comparison.
method.scope: Component general-picture synthesis evidence on consumed development; not whole-file authenticity, face-swap/lip-sync validation or calibrated source-time localization
method.calibration: Each method separately: same common applicable original calibration rows per dataset, both formats together; equal truth classes; clipped logits[-20,20], nonnegative Platt slope, ridge .01*(slope-1)^2, L-BFGS-B start[1,0] unchanged published numerical fitter
method.missing: Every288 planned rows retained; no score means inconclusive, never original; expected unavailable4 remain in denominator; no failure-driven case replacement
method.statistics: Shared prior video summary implementation; paired Brier/logloss uncertainty resamples source groups2000times seed901; variants do not constitute independent originals
method.native_audit: First source by SHA256(id) in each dataset/truth/format/role cell:16 cases, regardless of response. Separate FFmpeg CLI capture versus OpenCV exact RGB/tensor, native decoded PTS within1.1e-6s, candidate/baseline responses absolute1e-5. Paths share FFmpeg decoder lineage; not independently authored codecs. Missing support explicit.

gates.complete_matrix: All288 planned rows and exact source correspondence for both methods
gates.no_failures: Zero unexpected decode/inference failures; unsupported/known unavailable distinct
gates.calibration_support: Both truth classes and at least8 common independent calibration groups in each dataset
gates.brier_gain: Paired mean candidate-minus-baseline Brier <=-.005 in each dataset/format
gates.brier_interval: Upper paired Brier interval below0 in each dataset/format
gates.wrong_directions: At most1 additional false AI and1 false original in each dataset/format and overall
gates.ai_usefulness: At least4 additional distinct AI sources with an AI conclusion in some format, and lose at most2 correct AI conclusions in any dataset/format
gates.original_retention: Lose at most2 correct original conclusions in any dataset/format and overall
gates.scope_retention: Every baseline-assessed input still assessed by candidate
gates.native_correspondence: All16 fixed native/source replays pass or retain genuinely unassessed support; no failed audit

method.fresh_confirmation: Not permitted before every frozen development gate passes; new source/data freeze required
